item.title: PersonaStack 0.7.1
item.description:
# PersonaStack 0.7.1
Release date: 2026-10-04
## Upgrade notes
- Run Desktop Control setup again to verify the expanded permission checks. Full remote setup requires macOS 15 or later. Ordinary chat remains available on macOS 14. - Local persona execution now uses connections to installed Codex and Claude harnesses. Configure a harness connection for each persona and workspace you want to use. - Install PersonaStack through the included package for the signed locked-control component. Locked-session operation still requires qualification on your Mac.
## Added
- Added a guided Desktop Control setup flow for Accessibility, screen capture, protected files, browsers, clipboard and local-network access. - Added the pinned CUA tool catalog with owned sessions, local recording and bounded trajectory replay. Browser operations remain subject to local approval and CUA's supported security mode. - Added official CUA perception installation to setup on supported Apple Silicon Macs. Setup shows the download and asks for installation approval. Intel Macs do not have a supported perception package. - Added Codex and Claude harness connections with profile selection and activity reporting for each persona connection. - Added workspace skill upload and download through a selected local folder. - Added native pinned graph windows with clearer controls on light backgrounds.
## Changed
- Microphone approval now happens when you choose audio input in chat. Desktop Control setup no longer requests it. - Permission setup advances after verified approvals and offers targeted recovery when a check fails.
## Fixed
- Permission restart preserves setup navigation and allows a fresh setup attempt after relaunch. - Chat windows close without ending the conversation or waiting for chat availability. - Replacing a skill selected directly in a folder updates that skill in place. - Harness activity reporting covers every connection attached to the selected profile.

item.title: PersonaStack 0.6.0
item.description:
# PersonaStack 0.6.0
Release date: 2026-10-04
## Added
- Added Direct Capture, Safari Automation, Safari JavaScript and Clipboard checks to Desktop Control permission setup. macOS and Safari still require your approval where applicable. - Added a Refresh button beside the main window's Back and Forward controls.
## Changed
- Command-Q now hides PersonaStack's windows and keeps the menu bar, local runs and remote control running. Choose Quit PersonaStack from the menu bar icon to exit fully.
## Fixed
- Chat windows close immediately with the close button or Command-W, even when chat is unavailable. - Fixed Quit and permission restart getting stuck while native cleanup waits to run. Failed local cleanup stays visible and can be retried. - Permission setup rechecks newly approved notifications and microphone access. Restart-required rows use a yellow indicator. - Full Disk Access setup preserves existing approval and gives clearer instructions for adding the running app. Returning from Settings rechecks access. - Desktop Control gives specific recovery steps after failed or uncertain actions.

item.title: PersonaStack 0.5.0
item.description:
# PersonaStack 0.5.0
Release date: 2026-10-03
## Upgrade notes
- This release moves from the previous self-signed identity to PersonaStack, LLC's Apple Developer ID. macOS may require permission approval again. For Accessibility, remove the old PersonaStack entry and add PersonaStack.app from Applications. For Screen Recording and Microphone, turn PersonaStack off and on. Relaunch if macOS requests it. - Open Install PersonaStack.pkg in the disk image. Installation and updates require administrator approval. The package installs the app and its locked-control component together. - Existing Desktop Control credentials migrate when macOS allows a silent read. If an older credential is blocked, sign in and use Add this desktop to set up a new connection.
## Added
- Added Back and Forward buttons beside the main window controls. They follow the page's navigation history. - Added Desktop Control diagnostics in the menu bar.
## Changed
- The app and installer are signed with PersonaStack, LLC's Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple. - Desktop Control attempts an authorized operation without waiting for macOS to confirm the screen is unlocked. The operation reports its actual result. - Chat and activity popout windows use consistent titlebar sizing. - Chat, Stack Stream and Live Console windows remember their size and position and share an Always on top control.
## Fixed
- Removed repeated Keychain prompts when Desktop Control reads its saved machine credential. - Improved recovery guidance when macOS still holds an older Accessibility approval. - Check Screen Capture approval independently from Accessibility approval. - Reject incomplete Desktop Control setup instead of reporting the machine ready. - Improved Desktop Control command cancellation and connection recovery. - Permission setup refreshes macOS approval and explains when PersonaStack must restart. - Menu bar submenus stay open while connection status refreshes. - Downloads and external links follow the selected server's navigation rules. - Local Run command input and cancellation remain responsive during worker communication.

# PersonaStack 0.4.0
Release date: 2026-10-01
## Added
- Added a Concern Notifications toggle in Settings. Concern banners are enabled by default and can be turned off without disabling update notifications.
## Changed
- Concern notifications stay available when the main window is closed, including when Desktop Control has not been set up. - Organized the menu bar into Desktop Control, Settings and Updates menus. Open PersonaStack is first, with connection status and the current retry, pause or resume action directly below it. - Combined update information into one menu entry with download progress and the next available action.
## Fixed
- Accessibility approval now uses the current macOS permission status. Checking or approving it no longer runs a desktop action or moves the cursor. - Accessibility approval remains separate from Screen Capture checks and desktop runtime availability.
Concern notifications currently cover the workspace selected in the app. Notifications from all owned or administered workspaces require a separate website update.

# PersonaStack 0.3.3
Release date: 2026-10-01
## Fixed
- Opening Desktop Control and checking setup status no longer trigger Keychain password prompts. - Retry Remote Control in the menu bar can restore access to an existing Desktop Control credential without replacing the installation. - Pending Keychain authorization no longer stalls background connection checks. - Delayed startup and status checks no longer leave an old Keychain error after access is restored. - Older saved credentials use the most recent matching server entry during migration.
If Desktop Control needs Keychain access, choose **Retry Remote Control** from the PersonaStack menu. If macOS asks for authorization, choose **Always Allow** to remember this app. Older credentials can require this once after updating.

# PersonaStack 0.3.1
Release date: 2026-10-01
## Fixed
- Opening Desktop Control and checking setup status no longer trigger Keychain password prompts. - Retry Remote Control in the menu bar can restore access to an existing Desktop Control credential without replacing the installation. - Older saved credentials use the most recent matching server entry during migration.
If Desktop Control needs Keychain access, choose **Retry Remote Control** from the PersonaStack menu. If macOS asks for authorization, choose **Always Allow** to remember this app. Older credentials can require this once after updating.

# PersonaStack 0.3.0
Release date: 2026-10-01
## Added
- Run Local guides installation and startup of Apple's container runtime on Apple silicon with macOS 26 or later. Installation requires macOS approval.
## Fixed
- Accessibility and Screen Capture setup now request session confirmation when needed before reusing the desktop service. - Screen Capture setup reports when a remote task is using the desktop and keeps that task running.

# PersonaStack 0.2.7
Release date: 2026-10-01
## Fixed
- Opening Desktop Control setup automatically verifies current Accessibility, Screen Capture, Full Disk Access, Microphone and applicable Local Network access. Reopening setup runs fresh checks after an app restart or page change. - Permissions that need approval retain their Setup actions. Automatic checks preserve active recordings and remote tasks. Optional checks do not delay Finish after Accessibility is verified. - Microphone checks discard their short test recording. Protected-folder checks discard directory entries without reading file contents. Closing setup or choosing Finish cancels pending checks.

# PersonaStack 0.2.6
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Reopening Desktop Control setup preserves valid Microphone verification without recording another audio test. - Previously verified Full Disk Access and Local Network checks refresh when setup reopens or regains focus. Failed checks keep their recovery instructions and wait for an explicit retry. - Closing setup or choosing Finish cancels pending checks and prevents old results from replacing newer permission status.

# PersonaStack 0.2.5
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Full Disk Access now shows Ready after a successful protected-folder access check instead of Unsupported. After enabling it in System Settings, choose Setup Full Disk Access, then Check Access. - The access check also works with the Messages folder when the Mail folder is absent.

# PersonaStack 0.2.4
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Permission repair can reopen the setup window while keeping the existing Desktop Control integration connected. - Reopening permissions preserves any enrollment already in progress.

# PersonaStack 0.2.3
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Fixed a race where finishing setup during an optional screen check could stop the desktop service and make enrollment fail. - Cancelled permission setup now finishes its own startup and shutdown cleanup before enrollment starts the desktop service.

# PersonaStack 0.2.2
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Finish Setup now becomes available after Accessibility is verified. The permission is labeled (Required). - Screen Capture, Microphone, Full Disk Access and Local Network are optional for setup. Screen Capture is still needed for screenshot-based control. - Fixed hidden screen-capture checks blocking Accessibility-only desktop control. - Fixed optional permission checks interfering with setup completion or disabling working desktop control.

# PersonaStack 0.2.1
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Fixed Launch at Login setup skipping registration when macOS had not seen PersonaStack's login item before. - Replaced the incorrect missing-service and install-in-Applications message with registration recovery guidance. - Kept pending approval and unconfirmed registration visible until macOS confirms that launch at login is enabled.

# PersonaStack 0.2.0
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Changed
- Simplified Desktop Control setup to Accessibility, Screen Capture, Full Disk Access and Microphone. Local Network appears only when needed for the selected services. - Combined Screen Recording and Direct Capture into one Screen Capture step. Full Disk Access replaces separate folder and volume approval steps. - Automatically set up notifications, launch at login, updates and sleep prevention when you open the setup window. Confirmed settings show a check. macOS may still ask for approval.
## Fixed
- Notifications and launch at login no longer block Desktop Control setup when approval is pending or unavailable.
Full Disk Access still needs manual approval in System Settings. Its broad access remains unverified. Desktop Control remains unavailable while this Mac is locked.

# PersonaStack 0.1.63
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Microphone setup waits for recording to start and produce audio instead of ending the test after 200 milliseconds. - Microphone setup distinguishes an empty recording from a page-script failure and shows the appropriate retry guidance.

# PersonaStack 0.1.62
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Desktop Control setup rechecks desktop availability before marking setup complete. - Finishing an older setup attempt no longer closes a newer permissions checklist. - Returning from the lock screen during permission setup no longer starts an enrolled Desktop Control session.

# PersonaStack 0.1.61
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Accessibility setup no longer rejects valid replies from the Desktop Control service. - Accessibility verification correctly identifies its test controls and allows window and input updates to finish. - Accessibility setup opens macOS Settings before running desktop checks when approval is missing. - Accessibility failures now name the step that failed instead of reporting a generic screen-capture error.

# PersonaStack 0.1.60
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Screen Recording and Direct Capture now request access before opening macOS Settings so PersonaStack can appear in the permission list. - Accessibility verification no longer requires Screen Recording to be enabled first. - Microphone setup can verify recording on the current hosted app even when its voice-test helper is unavailable. Test audio is discarded. - File and network checks keep their results when macOS returns focus after a permission prompt. - Permission setup shows specific guidance for a required restart, a busy recorder, a missing microphone, or a failed recording test.

# PersonaStack 0.1.59
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Fixed the app's signing identity so macOS can identify PersonaStack consistently across updates. - Added recovery instructions when Settings shows an enabled permission that macOS is not granting to the current app.
## Changed
- This release uses a persistent self-signed certificate. It is not Developer ID signed or notarized. - Reapprove permissions once after updating from an unsigned build. For Accessibility, remove the old PersonaStack entry and add PersonaStack.app from Applications. For Screen Recording and Microphone, turn PersonaStack off and on in Settings. Relaunch if macOS requests it, then retry the Setup buttons.

# PersonaStack 0.1.58
Release date: 2026-09-30
## Fixed
- Fixed Desktop Control permission checks rejecting the macOS service after Accessibility or Screen Recording access was granted. - Reduced the menu bar icon size by 10% to better match nearby icons.

# PersonaStack 0.1.57
## Improvements
- Run personas in a dedicated local chat window using Apple containers. Local Run requires Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later, and the Apple container runtime. - Check access to mounted external and network volumes from the permission checklist. Choose a volume to verify access. - Check protected folder access from the permission checklist with guidance for opening macOS privacy settings.
## Fixes
- Verify microphone access through the same recorder used for voice attachments. - Preserve completed permission-check results while the checklist refreshes. - Show readable release notes inside the update window instead of only a GitHub comparison link.
